petAId.description: Challenger pet ID. ON DELETE RESTRICT — pet row is retained for audit integrity.

petBId.description: Opponent pet ID. NULL if isAiOpponent = true or if the pet row has been administratively removed.

isAiOpponent.description: TRUE = petA fought an AI-controlled opponent; petBId is always NULL for AI matches.

mode.description: Battle mode. RACE = speed-based; SUMO = strength-based.

winnerPetId.description: Pet ID of the winning pet. NULL when the AI opponent wins. Must be petAId or petBId.

randomSeed.description: Seeded random value used for the ±15% outcome modifier. Enables deterministic replay.

statDeltaA.description: Food buff bonus (delta) added to petA's base stat for this match. 0 = no active buff.

statDeltaB.description: Food buff bonus (delta) added to petB's base stat for this match. 0 = no active buff or AI opponent.

durationSeconds.description: Animation window duration in seconds (5–15 s).

battleLog.description: Structured event sequence array for client-side replay.

isFlagged.description: TRUE = match has been flagged by a moderator for review.

flaggedAt.description: Timestamp when the match was most recently flagged. NULL when isFlagged = false.

completedAt.description: UTC timestamp when the battle result was committed.

updatedAt.description: UTC timestamp of the last mutation (flag/unflag).
